title: MCPManifest
description: S1 canonical MCP authority. All values that look like secrets must be ${VAR} references to externally owned configuration — never literal secret values. Runtime files are deterministic projections of this manifest (see scripts/sync-mcp.js).

enabled.description: Generate and wire this server. Disabled servers are omitted from every projection.

required.description: If true, an unusable server fails aiw start closed for runtimes that project it. If false, warn and continue.

command.description: Executable + args as an array (never shell strings). Required for stdio.

args.description: Extra args appended after command (stdio). Prefer embedding args in command.

env_refs.description: Server env name -> ${VAR} reference. Values must be references, never literals.

headers.description: HTTP header name -> value or ${VAR} reference. Values must be references when secret.

cwd.description: Working directory for stdio servers, if portable.

trust.description: Safe default is prompt. auto must never weaken AIW HITL/governance; runtimes without a safe mapping treat it as unsupported and stay conservative.

compatibility.description: Adapter IDs this server projects to. Runtimes not listed are skipped for this server.
